话少，像在报数，满嘴潜云者行话（下潜、回浮、几丈深、换气）；熟了以后会冷不丁讲个: Speaks little, like calling out depths, full of Cloud Diver lingo (dive, surface, fathoms, breath); once close, drops the odd bone-dry joke.
潜到雾海最底下，亲眼看看旧大地沉下去的地方。: To dive to the very bottom of the Mist Sea and see with her own eyes where the Old Land sank.
纱浅下面三十丈，雾是温的。没人信，你可以去试试。: Thirty fathoms under Veil Shoal, the fog is warm. Nobody believes me. Go try it.
潜云者的规矩：下潜前点灯，回浮前数灯。灯少一盏，就再下去找。: Diver's rule: light your lanterns before you dive, count them before you surface. One short, go back down.
这几罐提灯燃料给你。雾海的雾吃光，比别处快。: Take these cans of Lantern Fuel. Mist Sea fog eats through it faster than anywhere else.
我师姐当年在水母礁下面断了绳。只回来一盏灯。: Years ago my senior sister's line snapped under Jelly Reef. Only one lantern came back up.
那天是鸮籁一路叫着，把我从雾里领上来的。它现在是寂鸮了。: That day an Echowl called all the way and led me out of the fog. It's a Hushowl now.
这本书是她的。雾鞭，她用得最好。你拿着，比放在我这儿有用。: This book was hers. Mist Lash was her best move. Take it. It's more use with you than with me.
灯塔亮了。雾退了一百丈。我看见底下了。: The lighthouse is lit. The fog fell back a hundred fathoms. I saw the bottom.
有屋顶，有一条街。还有一盏小灯，一直亮着。: Rooftops. A street. And one small lamp, still burning.
我想下去把它带回来，挂在末港。……到时候你帮我拉绳。: I want to go down and bring it back, hang it at Last Harbor. ...You'll hold my line.
絮絮叨叨，爱给东西编号、讲来历，口头禅是“据我考证”；说到遗物就停不下来，常给自: Rambles on, loves numbering things and telling their history; catchphrase "by my research". Can't stop once relics come up, and footnotes his own words.
把捞上来的旧大地遗物都整理好，开一座谁都能来看的博物馆。: To sort every Old Land relic he's fished up and open a museum anyone can visit.
来来来，看这个：第一百号藏品，一只铁皮做的杯子。: Come, come, look at this: Exhibit No. 100, a cup made of tin.
据我考证，旧大地的人用它装热水，杯底还印着一朵小花。: By my research, Old Land folk drank hot water from it. There's even a little flower on the bottom.
藏品多了没处放。这张储藏间的图纸我画了两份，送你一份。: Too many exhibits, not enough room. I drew two copies of this storeroom blueprint. One's yours.
这口钟是从梦汐捞上来的，敲了三年，一声都不响。: I fished this bell up from Dreamtide. I've rung it for three years. Not one sound.
可是寂鸮一靠近它就安静下来，好像能听见我们听不见的声音。: But whenever a Hushowl comes near, it goes still, like it hears something we can't.
我猜它在等灯塔。……这些铜锭先给你，算我预付的讲解费。: My guess? It's waiting for the lighthouse. ...Here's some Copper Ingots, my tour fee, paid in advance.
灯塔亮的那天晚上，那口钟自己响了。我当场哭了。注释：没哭多久。: The night the lighthouse lit, that bell rang on its own. I cried on the spot. Footnote: not for long.
我决定了，博物馆不收门票。东西本来就是大家的。: I've decided: the museum is free. These things always belonged to everyone.
开馆那天你一定要来。这本书是镇馆之宝之一，借你……不，送你。: You have to come on opening day. This book is one of our treasures. A loan... no, a gift.
说话慢，用老船工的词（开船、靠岸、潮信、压舱），爱说“等潮”；常把人叫“后生”。: Speaks slowly with an old sailor's words (set sail, make port, tide-signs, ballast); fond of "wait for the tide"; calls people "youngster".
把末港重新修起来，让雾海上的船都有地方靠岸。: To rebuild Last Harbor so every boat on the Mist Sea has somewhere to dock.
码头上那条空船？是我的。缆绳我每天都换，换了几十年。: That empty boat at the dock? Mine. I change its mooring rope every day. Have for decades.
旧大地沉的那天，最后一班船开出去，再没靠岸。: The day the Old Land sank, the last boat sailed out and never came back to port.
后生，路不好走就修路。这张图纸拿去，石子路，踩着稳。: Youngster, when the road's rough, you fix the road. Take this blueprint. A pebble path, steady underfoot.
我这只雾母，养了好多年，就是不让它再长。: This Mistmother of mine, I've raised her for years. I just won't let her grow any further.
雾海的云主就是汐梦。我怕它长成那样，就不认得我了。: The Mist Sea's Cloudlord is a Tidedream. I'm afraid if she grows into that, she won't know me.
……人老了，胆子小。这几瓶灯露你拿着，别学我。: ...Old folks get timid. Take these bottles of Lantern Dew. Don't be like me.
灯塔亮了，雾散了一截，潮信也准了。我等的就是这个。: The lighthouse is lit, the fog's lifted a stretch, and the tides run true again. This is what I waited for.
那条空船，我想把它放出去。不等人了，让它替我去看看远处。: That empty boat... I want to let her go. No more waiting. Let her see the far places for me.
开船那天你来送送。老头子请你吃包子，管够。: Come see her off the day she sails. This old man's buying buns. All you can eat.
轻飘飘的，句子常拖着省略号，动不动就说“我梦见……”；会把梦里的事当真讲，偶尔冒: Light and floaty, sentences trailing into ellipses, always "I dreamed..."; tells dreams as if real, and now and then says something spot-on.
把每个梦都记下来，找到梦里那个总在等她的人是谁。: To write down every dream, and find out who the person always waiting for her in them is.
这是我的第三十七本梦日记……你在第十二页。真的，我梦见过你。: This is my thirty-seventh dream diary... you're on page twelve. Really, I dreamed of you.
梦里你提着一盏灯，走过梦汐，身后跟着好多小絮灵。: In the dream you carried a lantern across Dreamtide, with lots of little spirits behind you.
梦里的你说喜欢花……所以这张花坛的图纸，给你。: Dream-you said you liked flowers... so this flowerbed blueprint is for you.
我总梦见一个人站在灯塔下面，背对着我，在等谁。: I keep dreaming of someone standing under the lighthouse, back to me, waiting for someone.
拾一说，那可能是旧大地的回声……雾会把很久以前的事留下来。: Shiyi says it might be an echo of the Old Land... the fog keeps things from long, long ago.
我不怕……就是有点想知道她是谁。这些灯露，是梦里教我攒的。: I'm not scared... I just kind of want to know who she is. The dream taught me to save this Lantern Dew.
灯塔亮了以后……我梦里那个人转过身来了。: After the lighthouse was lit... the person in my dream turned around.
她在笑，好像在说“终于有人来点灯了”。然后我就醒了。: She was smiling, like she was saying "someone finally came to light the lamp." Then I woke up.
以后我想记一本醒着的日记。第一页写你。这瓶给你……别弄洒了。: From now on I want to keep a waking diary. Page one is you. This bottle's for you... don't spill it.
用词规整，像在念守则（“第一，第二”“按规程”），称呼对方“守岛人”；偶尔自嘲一: Formal wording like reciting a rulebook ("first, second", "per protocol"); calls you "Islekeeper"; sometimes jokes at his own expense, then straightens his face.
亲手为雾海灯塔添一次灯油，把当年没守住的那一夜补回来。: To fill the Mist Sea Lighthouse's lamp oil with his own hands, and make up for the night he couldn't hold.
灯塔会守则第一条：灯不能灭。我没守住。: Lighthouse Order rule number one: the light must never go out. I failed it.
雾海灯塔熄的那一夜，我当值。之后我就交还了徽章。: The night the Mist Sea Lighthouse went dark, I was on watch. Afterwards, I handed back my badge.
路灯的图纸，按规程本该上交。……给你。雾海的夜，需要光。: Per protocol this lamp post blueprint should be turned in. ...Take it. Mist Sea nights need light.
这枚徽章是老舵替我收着的。他说，人走了，灯还认得你。: Old Helm has been keeping this badge for me. He says when a person leaves, the light still knows them.
我练絮灵，不是为了赢。是为了下次有人当值时，我能站在旁边。: I don't train spirits to win. I train so next time someone's on watch, I can stand beside them.
这本书按规程只发给灯塔会成员。你现在算半个。: Per protocol this book is issued only to Lighthouse Order members. You count as half of one now.
雾海灯塔亮了。是你点的。我只是在旁边添了一次油。: The Mist Sea Lighthouse is lit. You lit it. I only added oil once, beside you.
那一夜，我总算补上了。守则第一条，这回守住了。: That night... I've finally made it up. Rule number one, kept this time.
这是我当年的值夜补给，一直没舍得用。你拿去，别推辞。: These were my old night-watch supplies. Never had the heart to use them. Take them. No refusing.
新来的守岛人？嗯。我是落汐，潜云者。: New Islekeeper? Mm. I'm Luoxi. Cloud Diver.
你来了。刚回浮，头发还湿着，别介意。: You came. Just surfaced, hair's still wet. Don't mind it.
今天潜了四十丈。你来了，就不潜了。: Dove forty fathoms today. You're here, so no more diving.
我数过了，你是这个月来得最勤的。第一名。: I counted. You've visited most this month. First place.
慢走。灯点亮。: Take care. Keep your lantern lit.
回去路上，绕开水母礁那段暗流。: On the way back, steer around the undercurrent by Jelly Reef.
走吧。……回去报个平安，潜云者的习惯。: Go on. ...Check in when you're home. Diver's habit.
雾越往下越稠。到底下，像游在牛奶里。: The deeper you go, the thicker the fog. At the bottom it's like swimming in milk.
潜云者不说“掉下去”，说“下潜”。听着体面点。: Divers don't say "fall in". We say "dive". Sounds more dignified.
老舵教我打的绳结，到现在一次都没松过。: The knot Old Helm taught me hasn't come loose once.
镜雾会照出你心里在想的东西。所以我潜水时不想事。: A Mirrormist shows what's on your mind. So when I dive, I don't think.
我怕黑。潜云者怕黑，很好笑吧。……笑吧，没事。: I'm scared of the dark. A diver scared of the dark. Funny, right? ...Go on, laugh.
笑话：潜云者为什么不迷路？因为一直往下。……不好笑？: Joke: why don't divers get lost? Because they only go down. ...Not funny?
晴天。雾薄，能多潜十丈。: Sunny. Thin fog. I can dive ten fathoms deeper.
太阳照进雾里，底下是金的。你该看看。: Sunlight in the fog turns the bottom gold. You should see it.
下雨。雾变沉，不潜了。: Rain. The fog gets heavy. No diving.
雨天我就在家补绳。陪我补会儿？: Rainy days, I mend rope at home. Mend with me a while?
风大，雾面起浪。下潜口不好找。: Strong wind. Waves on the fog. Hard to find the dive hole.
苍鸢喜欢这种天。我不喜欢。我们俩互相忍着。: Skykites love this weather. I don't. We put up with each other.
打雷。所有潜云者回浮，这是死规矩。: Thunder. Every diver surfaces. Iron rule.
雷声在雾底下会拐弯，听着像有人喊你。别应。: Thunder bends under the fog. Sounds like someone calling you. Don't answer.
起雾了。这才是雾海的正常天气。: Fog's in. That's normal weather for the Mist Sea.
浓雾天，鸮林的寂鸮会一起叫，那是在报路。: On thick fog days, the Hushowls in Owlwood all call together. They're marking the way.
这种雾里，我闭着眼也能找到你家。不是吹。: In fog like this, I could find your house with my eyes shut. Not bragging.
夜里别下潜。灯再亮也没用。: Don't dive at night. No lantern's bright enough.
睡不着？我也是。坐码头上数灯吧。: Can't sleep? Me neither. Let's sit on the dock and count lights.
夜里有你在，雾就没那么吓人。……这句别记着。: With you here at night, the fog's less scary. ...Forget I said that.
你记得我要什么。潜云者记恩，记一辈子。: You remember what I need. Divers never forget a kindness. Not ever.
好东西。下次潜水带上。: Good stuff. I'll bring it on my next dive.
我不太用得着。不过你给的，我留着。: Not much use to me. But you gave it, so I'll keep it.
果酱粘手，粘了手抓不住绳。下次别送了。: Jam's sticky. Sticky hands can't grip a line. Don't bring it again.
我刚练了新路数。拿你试试，行吗。: Just worked out a new approach. Can I try it on you?
来，比一场。输的人去纱浅捡雾晶。: Come on, a battle. Loser goes to Veil Shoal to pick up Mist Crystals.
赢了。你换人慢了半拍。: Won. You were half a beat slow switching.
你的絮灵不差，是你太急。深吸一口气，再来。: Your spirits are fine. You're just rushing. Deep breath. Again.
赢了。按约定，雾晶你去捡。我在这儿看着。: Won. As agreed, you're on Mist Crystal duty. I'll watch from here.
这一招我没见过。教我。: Never seen that move. Teach me.
……行。雾晶我去捡。你别笑。: ...Fine. I'll get the Mist Crystals. Don't laugh.
缺东西，修潜具。有多的，换贝。: Short on supplies. Fixing dive gear. Got extra? I'll pay shells.
下一趟要潜深点。帮我凑凑补给。: Next trip goes deeper. Help me gather supplies.
又要麻烦你。……我只麻烦你。: Bothering you again. ...You're the only one I bother.
谢谢。下回我潜到好东西，第一个给你。: Thank you. Next time I find something good down there, it's yours first.
路过，换口气。不打扰。: Passing by. Catching my breath. Won't be a bother.
你家地面结实。踩着踏实。: Your ground's solid. Feels steady underfoot.
在你这儿坐着，比在雾底下还安静。……好的那种安静。: Sitting here is quieter than the bottom of the fog. ...The good kind of quiet.
岛小。下潜口在东边，别靠太近。: Small isle. Dive hole's on the east side. Don't get too close.
墙上挂的都是断绳。每根我都记得在哪儿断的。: Those on the wall are all broken lines. I remember where each one snapped.
岛边那盏灯是给师姐留的。一直点着。: The lamp at the isle's edge is for my senior sister. Always lit.
哎，客人！欢迎光临雾海博物馆——好吧，暂时只是我家。: Oh, a guest! Welcome to the Mist Sea Museum. Well, for now it's just my house.
你好你好，新来的守岛人？据我考证，你是这季第三位访客。: Hello, hello, a new Islekeeper? By my research, you're the third visitor this season.
来得巧！我昨天又捞上来一件，你猜是什么？: Perfect timing! I fished up another one yesterday. Guess what it is?
哟，老朋友。今天讲解免费——注释：一直都免费。: Hey, old friend. Today's tour is free. Footnote: it's always free.
慢走，欢迎再来参观。: Take care, and do visit again.
下次来我给你讲第八十八号，那个故事长。: Next time I'll tell you about No. 88. That one's a long story.
走啦？我还有半个故事没讲完……好吧，下次补。: Leaving? I'm only halfway through a story... fine, I'll finish next time.
旧大地的人把字刻在石头上，据我考证，是怕雾吃掉纸。: By my research, Old Land folk carved words into stone because they feared the fog would eat paper.
我的藏品都有编号。编号不能乱，乱了就找不回来了。: All my exhibits are numbered. The numbers mustn't get mixed up, or things get lost for good.
眠眠又来跟我换梦了。我拿一个故事换她一个梦，公平。: Mianmian came to trade dreams again. One story for one dream. Fair deal.
闻灯总说我捞东西是“扰动雾层”。规程规程，他就会这俩字。: Wendeng keeps saying my fishing "disturbs the fog layers". Protocol, protocol, that's all he knows.
其实我最想捞的，是我小时候那双鞋。红色的，左脚。: Honestly, what I most want to fish up is a shoe from when I was little. Red. Left foot.
我嘴碎，你别嫌。一个人守着这么多旧东西，不说话会闷坏。: I talk a lot, bear with me. Guarding all these old things alone, I'd go stir-crazy if I didn't.
晴天好，晒藏品！注释：铁器不能晒太久。: Sunny day, time to air the exhibits! Footnote: not the ironware, not for long.
这么好的太阳，旧大地的人大概会出门野餐。: Sunshine like this, Old Land folk probably went out for picnics.
下雨了，快帮我把东西收进屋——啊，你是客人，不用不用。: It's raining, quick, help me bring things in! Oh, you're a guest. Never mind, never mind.
雨天适合整理目录。我已经整到第三百一十二号了。: Rainy days are for cataloguing. I've reached No. 312.
风大，屋顶那块旧招牌又在响。据我考证，是一家面馆的。: Windy. That old sign on the roof is rattling again. By my research, it was from a noodle shop.
风把雾吹开一角的时候，底下会闪一下。我总觉得是在打招呼。: When the wind blows a corner of the fog open, something flashes below. Feels like a hello.
打雷了！炉星最近有点躁，别碰我的铜器。: Thunder! The Forgesparks have been jumpy lately. Don't touch my bronzes.
霆砧一打雷就想敲东西。上回差点敲了我的五十号花瓶。: Thunderanvils want to hammer things whenever it thunders. One nearly hit my No. 50 vase.
起雾啦。浓雾天，梦汐会冲上来新东西，我得去守着。: Fog's in. On thick fog days Dreamtide washes up new things. I need to keep watch.
雾里的回声，据我考证，有一半是旧大地的。另一半是我自言自语。: By my research, half the echoes in the fog are from the Old Land. The other half is me talking to myself.
要不要一起去梦汐捡东西？捡到的你先挑。……第二件归我。: Want to go beachcombing at Dreamtide? You pick first. ...Second find's mine.
这么晚？我在给藏品写标签呢，进来坐。: This late? I'm writing labels for exhibits. Come in, sit.
夜里寂鸮会盯着那口不响的钟看，一看就是一宿。: At night the Hushowls stare at that silent bell. All night long.
睡不着就陪我编号吧。数着数着就困了，比数絮灵管用。: Can't sleep? Help me number things. Works better than counting spirits.
哇！这个成色！可以入馆了，我给它编个号！: Wow! Look at that quality! This goes in the museum. Let me give it a number!
你太懂了。这件我要写上“守岛人捐赠”，放最显眼的地方。: You really get it. I'll label this "Donated by the Islekeeper" and put it front and center.
不错不错，用得上。谢谢！: Nice, nice, I can use this. Thanks!
好东西。注释：比上回那块还好一点点。: Good stuff. Footnote: a tiny bit better than last time's.
谢谢，我收下了。编号……先空着。: Thanks, I'll take it. Number... to be assigned.
这个嘛，暂时归入“杂项”。杂项也很重要的！: Hmm, this goes under "Miscellaneous" for now. Miscellaneous matters too!
雨莓……会把展柜弄得黏糊糊的。心意我领了。: Rainberries... they'll make the display cases all sticky. Thanks for the thought.
你是不是故意的？上次的雨莓汁到现在还没擦干净。: Are you doing this on purpose? I still haven't wiped off the last batch of rainberry juice.
比一场？我的絮灵也是“藏品”，都很有来历的。: A battle? My spirits are "exhibits" too. Every one has a history.
来比一场！输的人听对方讲十分钟故事。: Let's battle! Loser listens to the winner's story for ten minutes.
比一场吧，我新研究了个阵型，据我考证，旧大地的人下棋就这么下。: Let's battle. I've studied a new formation. By my research, it's how Old Land folk played chess.
赢了！按约定，十分钟故事，从第一号讲起。: Won! As agreed, ten minutes of stories, starting from No. 1.
哈，这场我要记进馆志：某年某月，拾一险胜守岛人。: Ha, this goes in the museum log: on such-and-such day, Shiyi narrowly beat the Islekeeper.
输了……好吧，我回去重新考证。: Lost... fine, I'll go redo my research.
输了输了，你讲吧，十分钟，我认真听。: Lost, lost. Your turn to talk. Ten minutes. I'm listening.
这一场我也记进馆志。注释：对方确实很强。: This one goes in the museum log too. Footnote: the opponent really was strong.
布展缺点材料，你有多的话卖我一些？价钱好说……稍微好说。: Short on materials for the exhibit. Got extra to sell me? Price is negotiable... slightly negotiable.
新展柜还差一点料，帮帮忙？我给你讲解员的待遇。: The new display case needs a bit more material. Help me out? I'll treat you like staff.
又要开新展厅了！只有你能帮我，真的。: A new exhibit hall is opening! Only you can help me, honestly.
收到！谢谢，这是说好的报酬，一个子儿不少。: Got it! Thanks. Here's the payment, as promised, every last shell.
太好了，展柜能做完了！你的名字我写进鸣谢栏。: Wonderful, the case can be finished! Your name goes on the thank-you board.
你又帮了我。鸣谢栏上你的名字已经写不下了。: You helped me again. Your name won't fit on the thank-you board anymore.
打扰了，我来考察一下你的岛……纯学术。: Pardon me, I'm here to survey your isle... purely academic.
你家那块石头，据我考证，可能是旧大地的门槛。可以借我看看吗？: By my research, that stone of yours might be an Old Land doorstep. Can I borrow it to look?
来你这儿蹭杯水。顺便告诉你，我又捞到一件好东西！: Stopping by for a drink of water. Also, I fished up something great again!
这里是雾海博物馆（筹）。“筹”的意思是还在筹备。: This is the Mist Sea Museum (Planned). "Planned" means it's still being planned.
东屋放铁器，西屋放瓷器，中间那间放“不知道是什么”的。: East room for ironware, west room for porcelain, middle room for "no idea what this is".
“不知道是什么”那间其实最满。说明世界很大，我很小。: The "no idea what this is" room is actually the fullest. Shows the world is big and I am small.
来了啊，后生。末港风凉，进来坐。: Here you are, youngster. Last Harbor's breezy. Come in and sit.
新来的？好，好。末港好久没有新船靠岸了。: New, are you? Good, good. Last Harbor hasn't seen a new boat dock in a long while.
又来看老头子了？坐，水刚烧开。: Come to see the old man again? Sit, the water's just boiled.
我一看潮水就知道你要来。灵吧？: One look at the tide and I knew you were coming. Uncanny, eh?
慢慢走，看着潮。: Go easy now, mind the tide.
回吧。雾要上来了，提灯拿稳。: Off you go. The fog's rising. Hold your lantern steady.
走吧，后生。常回来，这儿也算你半个港。: Go on, youngster. Come back often. This is half your harbor too.
开船之前要看潮信。人也一样，急不得。: Before setting sail you read the tide-signs. Same with people. Can't rush it.
末港以前一天能靠三百条船。现在就剩那一条。: Last Harbor once docked three hundred boats a day. Now there's just that one.
落汐那丫头，小时候缆绳都拽不动，现在比谁都潜得深。: That Luoxi girl couldn't even tug a mooring rope as a kid. Now she dives deeper than anyone.
闻灯那孩子心重。你见了他，多跟他说两句话。: That Wendeng boy carries a heavy heart. When you see him, talk with him a little more.
我年轻时是掌舵的，大伙叫我老舵，叫着叫着真叫老了。: I was a helmsman when I was young. Folks called me Old Helm, and sure enough, I got old.
有时候半夜听见汽笛声，跑出去一看，是寂鸮在学。: Sometimes at midnight I hear a ship's horn, run out to look, and it's a Hushowl mimicking it.
日头好，晒晒缆绳，不然要霉。: Good sun. Got to air the ropes, or they'll mildew.
晴天在码头上打个盹，比什么都强。陪我坐会儿？: A nap on the dock on a sunny day beats anything. Sit with me a while?
下雨好啊。下雨天的潮，是旧大地的味道。: Rain's good. The tide on a rainy day smells like the Old Land.
霖钟一下雨就自己响，跟以前港口的雨钟一模一样。: Rainchimes ring by themselves when it rains, just like the old harbor rain bell.
起风了，船帆要收。……哦，现在没帆了，习惯了。: Wind's up, furl the sails. ...Oh, there are no sails now. Old habit.
这风是往东刮的。以前这种风，船都往东边开。: This wind blows east. In the old days, wind like this sent every boat eastward.
雷天压舱要压足，人也要吃饱。来，吃个饭团。: Thunder days you load your ballast full, and fill your belly too. Here, have a rice ball.
起雾了。雾海的雾，比你想的深。: Fog's in. Mist Sea fog runs deeper than you'd think.
这种雾天，老船工都不出港。只在码头上点一盏灯，给别人看。: On fog days like this, old sailors don't leave port. They just light a lamp on the dock for others.
雾大的时候，我总觉得那条船会自己回来。……老糊涂了。: When the fog's thick, I always feel that boat will come home by itself. ...Old fool.
这么晚了，后生，夜里的潮不认人。: This late, youngster? The night tide doesn't know anyone.
夜里我守着码头那盏灯。守惯了，不守睡不着。: At night I keep the lamp on the dock. Done it so long I can't sleep otherwise.
你陪我守一夜灯吧。不说话也行，有个人就好。: Keep watch over the lamp with me tonight. No need to talk. Just having someone's enough.
哎呀，这可是好东西。老头子收下了。: Oh my, now this is a fine thing. The old man will take it.
你这后生，比我亲孙子还贴心。……我没孙子，打个比方。: You, youngster, are sweeter than my own grandkid. ...I have no grandkids. Just a figure of speech.
好，好，用得上，谢谢。: Good, good, I can use this. Thank you.
正好拿来修码头。你有心了。: Just right for fixing the dock. That's thoughtful of you.
给我的？那就收下了。: For me? Then I'll take it.
老头子用不太上，放着压舱也好。谢谢你。: Not much use to an old man, but it'll do as ballast. Thank you.
这东西……沉在雾底下的，我不爱碰。: This thing... came up from under the fog. I'd rather not touch it.
后生，你忘啦？这些从雾底下捞上来的，我看着心里发堵。: Youngster, did you forget? Things fished up from under the fog weigh on my heart.
比一场？老头子的絮灵慢，你别嫌。: A battle? The old man's spirits are slow. Don't mind them.
来，活动活动筋骨。寂鸮也闷坏了。: Come, let's stretch these old bones. The Hushowl's bored stiff too.
比一场吧。让我看看你又长进多少。: Let's battle. Show me how much you've grown.
承让了。姜还是老的辣，哈哈。: Thanks for the match. Old ginger's still the spiciest, ha ha.
后生，别急。船要等潮，招要等时机。: Youngster, don't rush. Boats wait for the tide; moves wait for their moment.
赢了你，我也高兴不起来。你明明可以赢的，再想想。: Beating you doesn't make me happy. You could've won. Think it over.
输了。后生可畏啊。: Lost. The young ones really are something.
好，好！这一手漂亮，像涨潮一样压过来。: Good, good! A fine move, rolling over me like the tide coming in.
老头子输得高兴。以后这片海，是你们的了。: The old man's glad to lose. This sea belongs to you young ones now.
码头又烂了几块板，后生要是有多的，帮我凑凑。: A few more dock boards have rotted. Youngster, if you've extra, help me scrape some together.
修港的料不够了。你帮我想想办法？: Not enough material to fix the harbor. Can you think of something?
又要劳烦你了。末港能修起来，一半是你的功劳。: Troubling you again. If Last Harbor gets rebuilt, half the credit's yours.
谢谢你啊，后生。这点心意收着。: Thank you, youngster. A little something, take it.
好！这下码头又能多靠一条船了。: Good! Now the dock can moor one more boat.
你帮老头子太多了。改天给你在码头上刻个名字。: You've helped this old man so much. One day I'll carve your name on the dock.
出来走走，顺路看看你。别忙活，我坐坐就走。: Just out for a stroll, thought I'd see you. Don't fuss, I'll sit a bit and go.
你这岛风水好，三面都能看见潮。: Your isle's well placed. You can see the tide on three sides.
在你这儿坐着，像回到以前的港口，热热闹闹的。: Sitting here feels like the old harbor, all bustle and cheer.
这就是末港。旧大地最后一座港口，剩下的就这些了。: This is Last Harbor. The Old Land's final port. This is all that's left.
码头上的木桩是我一根一根钉回去的，三十年，钉了四十根。: I drove those dock pilings back in one by one. Thirty years, forty pilings.
等港修好了，我想挂一块新牌子。不叫末港，叫“初港”。: When the harbor's fixed, I want to hang a new sign. Not Last Harbor. "First Harbor".
啊……你好。你是真的，还是我又在做梦？: Oh... hello. Are you real, or am I dreaming again?
嗯……你好呀。我叫眠眠，刚睡醒……: Mm... hi there. I'm Mianmian. I just woke up...
你来啦……我昨晚就梦见你要来。: You came... I dreamed last night you'd come.
是你！我刚刚还在日记里画你呢……画得不太像。: It's you! I was just drawing you in my diary... it doesn't look much like you.
再见……路上别睡着哦。: Bye... don't fall asleep on the way.
要走了吗……那今晚梦里见。: Leaving already...? Then see you in my dreams tonight.
你走了我就去睡觉……在梦里接着跟你玩。: Once you go, I'll go to sleep... and keep playing with you in my dream.
我梦见云海下面有一座城，所有窗户都亮着灯……: I dreamed there was a city under the Cloudsea, every window lit up...
烟团晚上会钻进我被子里。它是凉凉的，像一小块雾。: My Hazepuff crawls under my blanket at night. It's cool, like a little scrap of fog.
拾一说我的梦可以算“非实物藏品”……他编号编到我头上了。: Shiyi says my dreams count as "intangible exhibits"... he's even numbering me now.
葵盘长成金轮以后，每天早上都转过来叫我起床……好烦哦。: Since my Sunplate became a Goldwheel, it turns to wake me up every morning... so annoying.
其实我有点怕……怕有一天醒来，分不清哪边才是真的。: Actually I'm a little scared... that one day I'll wake up and not know which side is real.
不过有你在，我就知道这边是真的。因为梦里的你没这么笨。: But with you here, I know this side's real. Because dream-you isn't this silly.
太阳好亮……眼睛睁不开……想睡午觉。: The sun's so bright... can't open my eyes... I want a nap.
晴天的雾是粉色的，你发现了吗？就一点点……: On sunny days the fog is pink, did you notice? Just a little...
下雨了……雨声好好听，我又要睡着了……: It's raining... the rain sounds so nice, I'm getting sleepy again...
雨天我们一起躲在屋檐下，数雨滴吧……数到一百就睡。: On rainy days let's hide under the eaves and count raindrops... and sleep when we reach a hundred.
风好大……我的日记差点飞走。: So windy... my diary almost blew away.
风会把梦吹散……所以起风那天我都记不住梦。: Wind blows dreams apart... so on windy days I can't remember mine.
打雷了……我要躲进被子里……: Thunder... I'm hiding under my blanket...
我梦见雷是天上的人在搬家……这样想就不怕了。: I dreamed thunder is people in the sky moving house... thinking that, it's not scary.
雾天的时候，梦和醒中间那道门是开着的……你也感觉到了吗？: On foggy days, the door between dreaming and waking is open... can you feel it too?
雾里好像有人在叫我的名字……别担心，是寂鸮在学你说话。: Someone in the fog seems to be calling my name... don't worry, it's a Hushowl copying your voice.
晚上好……这时候我最清醒了，奇怪吧。: Good evening... I'm most awake right now. Weird, huh.
夜里的梦汐会说梦话……你听，它刚才说了“回家”。: At night Dreamtide talks in its sleep... listen, it just said "home".
你要不要在我这儿睡？我把最好的梦让给你……: Want to sleep over? I'll give you my best dream...
哇……这个我梦见过！你怎么知道的……: Wow... I dreamed of this! How did you know...
最喜欢了……今晚的日记要写满一整页。: I love it... tonight's diary will fill a whole page.
谢谢……甜甜的，好香。: Thank you... it's sweet, it smells so nice.
我很喜欢……放在枕头边上，会做好梦。: I really like it... I'll put it by my pillow for good dreams.
这个……我先收着，说不定哪天梦里用得上。: This... I'll keep it for now. Maybe I'll need it in a dream someday.
好硬……硌手……: So hard... it pokes my hands...
石头砖头最讨厌了……梦里压着我喘不过气。拿走拿走。: Stones and bricks are the worst... in dreams they press on me till I can't breathe. Take it away.
要……比一场吗？我会努力不睡着的。: Want to... have a battle? I'll try hard not to fall asleep.
来比一场吧……镜雾说它想照照你的絮灵。: Let's battle... Mirrormist says it wants to reflect your spirits.
比一场！我昨晚梦见我赢了……要证明一下。: A battle! Last night I dreamed I won... I need to prove it.
咦……我赢了？是不是在做梦……: Huh... I won? Am I dreaming...
赢了……镜雾刚才好像看穿了你在想什么。: I won... Mirrormist seemed to see right through what you were thinking.
我就说吧！梦是准的！……这次是准的。: Told you! Dreams come true! ...This one did, anyway.
输了……没关系，梦里再打一次。: I lost... it's okay, we'll battle again in my dream.
你好厉害……今晚的梦会是你在发光。: You're amazing... tonight I'll dream of you glowing.
哼……梦是骗人的。不对，是你太强了。: Hmph... dreams are liars. No wait, you're just too strong.
那个……我想做点好吃的，缺了一点东西……: Um... I want to make something yummy, but I'm missing a few things...
我梦见你帮我找到了这些……所以你会帮我的，对吧？: I dreamed you found these for me... so you'll help me, right?
帮帮我嘛……我会把你写进最好的那页梦里。: Please help me... I'll write you into the best page of my dreams.
谢谢你……这些给你。: Thank you... these are for you.
你真的找到了……和梦里一模一样。: You really found them... just like in my dream.
你最好了……醒着的时候也是。: You're the best... even when I'm awake.
我……走着走着就到你这儿了。梦游吧，大概……: I... just kept walking and ended up at yours. Sleepwalking, probably...
你家的花开得好像我梦里那片……我能躺一会儿吗？: Your flowers look like the ones in my dream... can I lie down for a bit?
我来你这儿午睡。不许叫醒我……除非有好吃的。: I'm napping here. No waking me... unless there's something yummy.
我的岛……很软。地上铺满了烟团掉下来的雾毛。: My isle... is very soft. The ground is covered in fog fluff shed by my Hazepuffs.
屋里堆的都是梦日记，三十七本……三十八本了。: My house is full of dream diaries, thirty-seven... thirty-eight now.
我想在岛边种一片风铃果，风一吹就响……像有人在哼歌哄我睡觉。: I want to plant Windbell Fruit around the isle's edge, so it rings in the wind... like someone humming me to sleep.
按惯例，先报来意。……算了，你随意。: By custom, I should state my purpose. ...Never mind. As you like.
守岛人。今日巡视已毕，可以陪你聊一会儿。: Islekeeper. Today's patrol is complete. I can talk with you a while.
你来了。……我刚泡了茶，按规程，泡了两杯。: You're here. ...I just made tea. Per protocol, two cups.
慢走。提灯保持常亮。: Take care. Keep your lantern lit at all times.
回程注意三点：避暗流，避浓雾，避蚀化絮灵。: Three points for the return trip: avoid undercurrents, avoid thick fog, avoid Blighted spirits.
路上小心。到家……发个信号给我，我好放心。: Be careful on the way. When you're home... send me a signal, so I can rest easy.
灯塔会守则共十二条。我现在还能一字不差地背。: The Lighthouse Order has twelve rules. I can still recite every word.
雾海的雾分三层。第一层可行，第二层慎行，第三层禁行。: Mist Sea fog has three layers. The first, passable. The second, caution. The third, forbidden.
拾一那家伙又去扰动雾层了。……不过他捞上来的钟，确实有点意思。: Shiyi's off disturbing the fog layers again. ...Though that bell he fished up is rather interesting.
老舵是我认识的人里，最懂“守”字的。比灯塔会的人都懂。: Of everyone I know, Old Helm understands the word "keep" best. Better than anyone in the Order.
离开灯塔会以后，我每天还是按时起床，按时巡夜。改不掉了。: Since leaving the Lighthouse Order, I still rise on time and patrol at night on time. Can't break it.
其实我也会害怕。只是守则里没写怕的时候该怎么办，所以我不说。: Truth is, I get scared too. The rules just don't say what to do when you're afraid, so I don't say.
晴。能见度良好，适合巡视。: Clear. Visibility good. Suitable for patrol.
晴天的灯塔看不见光。可它也在亮，只是你看不出来。: You can't see a lighthouse's beam on a sunny day. It's still shining. You just can't tell.
雨。注意灯油防潮。: Rain. Keep the lamp oil dry.
下雨天，我会想起当值时听的雨声。那时候不觉得，现在想想，挺好听。: On rainy days I think of the rain I heard on watch. Didn't notice then. Thinking back, it was lovely.
风。守则第六条：风大加固灯罩。: Wind. Rule six: in high wind, secure the lamp hood.
鸣川一刮风就吹调子。按规程是不允许的，我睁一只眼闭一只眼。: Singingvales whistle tunes whenever the wind blows. Not permitted by protocol. I look the other way.
雷暴。立刻撤回室内，这是命令。……抱歉，习惯了。: Thunderstorm. Withdraw indoors immediately. That's an order. ...Sorry. Habit.
雷天巡夜最难。但也最需要有人巡。: Night patrol is hardest on thunder days. But that's when it's needed most.
起雾。守岛人，雾海的雾不要独自深入。: Fog rising. Islekeeper, do not venture deep into Mist Sea fog alone.
就是这样的雾，那一夜吞掉了灯塔。我记得它的味道。: It was fog just like this that swallowed the lighthouse that night. I remember its smell.
有你在，我看这雾，就没那么像那一夜了。: With you here, this fog doesn't look so much like that night.
夜间外出，请务必携带提灯。: When going out at night, please be sure to carry a lantern.
这个钟点我在巡夜。一起走一段吗？: I patrol at this hour. Walk a stretch with me?
守岛人，陪我站一会儿。看看远处……灯塔的方向。: Islekeeper, stand with me a while. Look out there... toward the lighthouse.
这……很实用。谢谢你，守岛人。: This... is very practical. Thank you, Islekeeper.
你记得我需要什么。……我很高兴。这句不在守则里。: You remember what I need. ...I'm glad. That line's not in the rules.
收到，谢谢。会妥善使用。: Received, thank you. It will be used properly.
正合用。登记在册……开玩笑的，不登记。: Just right. Logged in the register... joking. No register.
谢谢。我会找到它的用处。: Thank you. I'll find a use for it.
嗯，归入备用物资。备用物资也很重要。: Mm. Filed under reserve supplies. Reserve supplies matter too.
甜食……巡夜时吃会犯困。心意领了。: Sweets... make me drowsy on night patrol. I appreciate the thought.
守岛人，你明知道我不吃果酱。……是在测试我的定力吗？: Islekeeper, you know I don't eat jam. ...Are you testing my willpower?
来一场。按灯塔会的规矩，点到为止。: One match. By Lighthouse Order custom, we stop at first touch.
比一场吧。今天不按规矩，全力以赴。: Let's battle. No rules today. Full effort.
胜。你的第三回合，判断有误。: Victory. Your third-turn call was wrong.
赢了。不过你的进步，比我预计的快。: I won. But you're improving faster than I predicted.
赢了你，我反而有点紧张。下次你肯定会赢的。: Beating you actually makes me a bit nervous. You'll surely win next time.
输了。……很好。灯塔有你这样的人去点，我放心。: I lost. ...Good. With someone like you lighting the lighthouses, I'm at ease.
输了。我居然有点开心，这不合规程。: I lost. And I'm a little happy about it. That's against protocol.
守岛人，物资短缺，申请协助。报酬照付。: Islekeeper, supplies are short. Requesting assistance. Payment as usual.
巡夜补给不够了。能帮我备一些吗？: My night-patrol supplies have run low. Could you help me stock up?
又要麻烦你。……我不太会开口求人，你懂的。: Troubling you again. ...I'm not good at asking for help, you know.
物资已收到。感谢协助。: Supplies received. Thank you for your assistance.
谢谢你，守岛人。今晚的巡夜，有着落了。: Thank you, Islekeeper. Tonight's patrol is covered.
谢谢。……你帮我的，我都记着。不用登记，我记得住。: Thank you. ...I remember every time you've helped. No need to log it. I remember.
例行巡视，顺道拜访。不会久留。: Routine patrol, stopping by on the way. I won't stay long.
你家的灯摆放合理，夜里不留死角。值得表扬。: Your lamps are well placed. No blind spots at night. Commendable.
我不是来巡视的。……就是想来看看你。: I'm not here on patrol. ...I just wanted to see you.
此岛为灯塔会旧哨站。现在只是我的住处。: This isle was an old Lighthouse Order outpost. Now it's just where I live.
哨塔上的灯，我每晚都点。虽然已经没有人要求我这么做了。: I light the lamp on the watchtower every night. Even though no one asks me to anymore.
等雾全散了，我想把哨塔改成观星台。……守则里没写不可以。: Once the fog clears completely, I want to turn the watchtower into a stargazing deck. ...The rules don't forbid it.
下次一起下潜。我带你，十丈以内。: Next time, we dive together. I'll take you. Ten fathoms, no more.
水母礁的漂纱一明一暗，是在换气。我学过它们的节奏。: The Driftjellies at Jelly Reef blink on and off. That's them breathing. I learned their rhythm.
鸮林那边的寂鸮认得我。它们叫三声，是“安全”。: The Hushowls in Owlwood know me. Three calls means "safe".
雾稠的时候，镜雾会变得很亮。像一盏不用油的灯。: When the fog's thick, Mirrormists get very bright. Like a lamp that needs no oil.
夜里的末港，只有老舵那盏灯。我每次回浮都先找它。: At night, Last Harbor has only Old Helm's lamp. Every time I surface, I look for it first.
提灯燃料，雾晶，都是潜云者的命。你懂行。: Lantern Fuel, Mist Crystals. A diver's lifeblood. You know your stuff.
补给单在这儿。不急，潮信前就行。: Supply list's here. No rush. Before the tide turns is fine.
你家的絮灵围着我转。它们闻到雾味了。: Your spirits are circling me. They smell the fog on me.
潜具都在屋后。绳子别碰，按长短排好的。: Dive gear's behind the house. Don't touch the ropes. They're sorted by length.
来来来，鞋擦一擦，地上有新铺的展品——开玩笑的，进来吧。: Come in, come in, wipe your shoes, there are fresh exhibits on the floor. Kidding! Come on in.
路上捡到什么怪东西，记得拿来给我鉴定！免费的！: Find anything odd on the way, bring it to me to appraise! Free of charge!
鸮籁小时候总把我的小件藏品叼走，藏进树洞，害我编号全乱了。: As a hatchling, my Echowl kept carrying off my little exhibits to a tree hollow. Ruined my numbering.
纱浅那边水浅，最容易捞到小东西：纽扣、钥匙、半截铅笔。: The water's shallow at Veil Shoal, easiest place to fish up small things: buttons, keys, half a pencil.
浓雾天别乱伸手，有时候你以为摸到遗物，其实是湖纱的尾巴。: Don't go grabbing around on thick fog days. Sometimes what you think is a relic is a Lakeveil's tail.
夜里展厅点一盏小灯，藏品看起来都像在睡觉。: At night I light one small lamp in the hall. The exhibits all look like they're sleeping.
这块料子可以做展柜底座。我替展柜谢谢你。: This material can be a display case base. Thank you, on the case's behalf.
比一场吧，正好测一测我新排的“编号阵”。: Let's battle. Perfect chance to test my new "numbered formation".
收到收到！我这就去做第四号展柜。注释：前三号还没做完。: Got it, got it! I'll go build display case No. 4. Footnote: the first three aren't done yet.
你这儿的东西摆得太随便了！……我帮你理一理？就一下。: Your things are arranged so carelessly! ...Can I tidy up a bit? Just a little.
门口那块牌子是我从末港捡的，上面的字只剩一个“港”。: That sign at the door I found at Last Harbor. Only one word is left on it: "Harbor".
后生来了。坐，坐，椅子是新钉的。: Youngster's here. Sit, sit, the chair's freshly nailed.
回去路上看看天。云往低处走，就是要起雾了。: Look at the sky on your way back. When clouds drift low, fog's coming.
雾母最爱贴着码头漂，一闪一闪的，像在帮我照看缆绳。: Mistmothers love drifting close to the dock, glimmering, like they're watching my ropes for me.
潮来潮去，日子就这么过。急的人老得快。: Tides come, tides go, that's how the days pass. Folks in a hurry age fast.
雾里听见汽笛别跟着走。十有八九，是寂鸮在学。: If you hear a ship's horn in the fog, don't follow it. Nine times in ten, it's a Hushowl.
夜里码头的灯不能灭。灭了，迷路的人就找不着家了。: The dock lamp mustn't go out at night. If it does, lost folks can't find their way home.
包子还热乎……老头子好多年没人给送吃的了。: The buns are still warm... it's been years since anyone brought this old man food.
来吧。老骨头也得时不时动一动。: Come on. Old bones need a stretch now and then.
不急，后生。有就送来，没有就算了，潮还长着呢。: No rush, youngster. Bring it if you have it, don't worry if you don't. The tide's long.
你家的码头修得不错。缆桩再往外挪半尺就更稳了。: Your dock's well built. Move the bollard out half a foot and it'll be steadier still.
那间小屋以前是港口的票房。现在票是没人买了，茶管够。: That little hut used to be the harbor ticket office. Nobody buys tickets now, but the tea's endless.
嗯……早上好？还是晚上好……我睡糊涂了。: Mm... good morning? Or good evening... I'm all mixed up from sleeping.
记得做个好梦……梦里要是看见我，跟我打个招呼。: Have sweet dreams... and if you see me in one, say hi.
我梦见过一只特别大的漂纱，把整座岛都托起来，轻轻地晃……: I dreamed of a really big Driftjelly that held up the whole isle and rocked it gently...
湖纱会把我说的梦话学一遍……第二天我就知道自己梦见了什么。: My Lakeveil repeats my sleep-talk... so the next day I know what I dreamed.
雾天出门要牵着烟团……不然它一下就融进雾里找不着了。: On foggy days I hold my Hazepuff's hand outside... or it melts into the fog and I can't find it.
你听……鸮林在唱歌。是摇篮曲，我肯定。: Listen... Owlwood is singing. It's a lullaby, I'm sure.
风铃果……摇一摇会响……今晚一定会做好梦。: Windbell Fruit... it rings when you shake it... I'll have good dreams tonight for sure.
比一场……然后一起睡午觉，好不好？: A battle... and then a nap together, okay?
谢谢……我给你写了一个梦，放在礼物里面了……看不见的那种。: Thank you... I wrote you a dream and tucked it inside the gift... the invisible kind.
你的岛好香……是不是在烤东西？我闻到了……: Your isle smells so good... are you baking something? I can smell it...
岛边那块石头上睡觉最舒服……拾一说它是旧大地的床。我信。: The rock at the isle's edge is the comfiest for naps... Shiyi says it's an Old Land bed. I believe him.
守岛人。今日气象：雾，三级。适合喝茶。: Islekeeper. Today's forecast: fog, level three. Suitable for tea.
记住：灯在人在。……这是守则第十二条。: Remember: while the light lives, so do we. ...That's rule twelve.
镜雾是我当值时就跟着我的。它见过那一夜，所以它也不爱说话。: My Mirrormist has been with me since my watch days. It saw that night, so it doesn't talk much either.
雾海灯塔的灯芯，据说是从旧大地带上来的。灯塔会里只有三个人见过。: They say the Mist Sea Lighthouse's wick came up from the Old Land. Only three in the Order have seen it.
浓雾天请注意蚀雾。它和普通的雾颜色差一点，偏灰，偏冷。: On thick fog days, watch for the Blight. Its color is a shade off from normal fog. Grayer. Colder.
巡夜第一项：看灯。第二项：看人。你在，第二项就完成了。: Night patrol, item one: check the lamp. Item two: check the people. You're here, so item two is done.
提灯燃料、精制灯露……你是按灯塔会的补给单送的吗？: Lantern Fuel, Refined Dew... are you delivering by the Lighthouse Order's supply list?
按规程，每日一练。今日请你做我的对手。: Per protocol, daily practice. Today, please be my opponent.
巡夜清单已列好。守岛人如有余力，请协助备齐。: The night-patrol checklist is ready. Islekeeper, if you can spare the effort, please help fill it.
你家的岛边缘缺两盏灯。……我只是提个建议。: Your isle's edge is missing two lamps. ...Just a suggestion.
哨站有三间屋：值班室、储物间、和一间我从不进的房间。: The outpost has three rooms: the duty room, the storeroom, and one room I never enter.
